title: Polite Requests and Offers
ringkas: Could/would/may, meminta tolong, menolak dengan sopan
goals: meminta tolong dengan sopan: [[Could you ...?]], [[Would you mind ...ing?]], [[I was wondering if ...]]
menawarkan bantuan: [[Shall I ...?]], [[Would you like me to ...?]], [[Can I help you with ...?]]
menerima dan menolak permintaan dengan sopan
membedakan tingkat **kesopanan**: santai, netral, dan sangat formal
memakai **pertanyaan tidak langsung** ([[Could you tell me where ...?]])

lesson.text: Di tempat kerja, **cara kita meminta** sering lebih penting daripada **apa yang diminta**. Kalimat seperti *Give me the file* terdengar kasar. Dengan *Could you send me the file, please?* permintaan yang sama terdengar sopan dan profesional.

lesson.title: 1. Tingkat kesopanan permintaan
table: [[I was wondering if you could help me with this.]]

lesson.title: Would you mind + V-ing
lesson.text: Setelah [[Would you mind]] pakai **V-ing**: [[Would you mind waiting?]] Untuk setuju, jawab [[Not at all.]] atau [[Of course not.]] (artinya *tidak keberatan*). Jawab [[I'm sorry, I do mind.]] hanya jika menolak.

lesson.title: 2. Menawarkan bantuan
table: [[Can I help you with the printer?]]
[[Would you like me to book a room?]]

lesson.title: 3. Menerima dan menolak
table: [[Certainly.]] / [[Of course.]] / [[Sure, no problem.]] / [[I'd be happy to.]]
[[Yes, please.]] / [[That would be great, thank you.]]
[[No, thank you. I can manage.]] / [[That's very kind, but I'm fine.]]
[[I'm afraid I can't. I have a deadline.]] / [[I'm sorry, but I'm not available.]]
[[I can't today, but I could do it tomorrow.]]

items.ex: Could I ask you a favour?
Could you lend me a pen?
Please reply today, otherwise we will cancel.

lesson.title: 5. Pertanyaan tidak langsung (lebih sopan)
table: [[Could you tell me where the manager's office is?]]
What time does the meeting start?
[[Do you know what time the meeting starts?]]
[[Could you tell me how much this is?]]

lesson.title: Urutan kata pada pertanyaan tidak langsung
lesson.text: Setelah pembuka sopan, urutan kembali seperti **kalimat biasa** dan tanpa do/does/did: [[Could you tell me where he **works**?]] (bukan *where does he work*).

lesson.title: 6. Berterima kasih dan menanggapinya
table: [[Thank you very much.]] / [[I really appreciate it.]] / [[Thanks in advance.]]

lines.en: Excuse me, Tom. Could you help me with the printer? It isn't working.
lines.id: Permisi, Tom. Bisakah kamu membantuku dengan printer? Printernya tidak berfungsi.

lines.en: Of course. Let me have a look. Would you mind waiting a moment?
lines.id: Tentu. Biar kulihat. Apakah kamu keberatan menunggu sebentar?

lines.en: Not at all. I really appreciate your help.
lines.id: Sama sekali tidak. Aku sangat menghargai bantuanmu.

lines.en: Dina, could you prepare the slides for tomorrow's meeting?
lines.id: Dina, bisakah kamu menyiapkan slide untuk rapat besok?

lines.en: I'm afraid I can't today because I'm finishing the sales report. But I could do it tomorrow morning.
lines.id: Sayangnya hari ini saya tidak bisa karena sedang menyelesaikan laporan penjualan. Tapi saya bisa mengerjakannya besok pagi.

lines.en: Hmm. The meeting is at ten. Would you like me to ask Tom to help you?
lines.id: Hmm. Rapatnya pukul sepuluh. Mau saya minta Tom membantumu?

lines.en: That would be great, thank you.

items: Permintaan: [[Can you]] (santai) → [[Could you]] (sopan) → [[Would you mind ...ing]] (lebih sopan) → [[I was wondering if ...]] (formal).
Tawaran: [[Shall I ...?]], [[Would you like me to ...?]], [[Let me ...]]
Menolak: [[I'm afraid I can't ...]] + alasan + alternatif.
Tidak langsung: [[Could you tell me where ... is?]], urutan seperti kalimat biasa.

Mungkinkah saya menerima materinya lewat email? Saya senang membacanya di rumah. Saya juga akan senang mengikuti sesi berikutnya, jika ada. Terima kasih atas pengertiannya. Salam, Tika

Hi Rizal, thank you for inviting me to join the weekend training. I really appreciate it. Unfortunately, I won't be able to attend because I have a family event on Saturday.
Would it be possible to receive the materials by email? I'd be happy to read them at home. I would also be glad to join the next session, if there is one. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards, Tika

read.id:
Rina perlu pulang lebih awal, jadi dia bertanya kepada manajernya, "Permisi, Pak Adi, bolehkah saya pulang pukul empat hari ini? Saya ada janji dengan dokter." Pak Adi berkata, "Tentu. Apakah Anda keberatan menyelesaikan laporan sebelum pergi?"
Rina menjawab, "Tentu. Saya bisa mengirimkannya sebelum pukul tiga." Kemudian, seorang rekan bertanya, "Bisakah kamu membantuku dengan printer?" Rina berkata, "Maaf, saya tidak bisa sekarang, tetapi maukah saya minta Dina membantu Anda?" Rekannya berkata, "Itu bagus sekali. Terima kasih."

Rina needs to leave early, so she asks her manager, "Excuse me, Mr. Adi, could I leave at four today? I have a doctor's appointment." Mr. Adi says, "Of course. Would you mind finishing the report before you go?"
Rina answers, "Certainly. I can send it before three." Later, a colleague asks, "Could you help me with the printer?" Rina says, "I'm afraid I can't right now, but shall I ask Dina to help you?" The colleague says, "That would be great. Thank you."

read.focus: Would, could, dan would you mind untuk permintaan sopan
read.id:
Pak Hadi, sang manajer, menulis kepada timnya. "Saya akan menghargai jika Anda dapat mengirimkan laporan penjualan paling lambat Jumat. Apakah Anda keberatan memeriksa angkanya sekali lagi? Jika Anda bisa menambahkan ringkasan singkat, itu akan lebih baik."
Rina membalas, "Tentu, Pak Hadi. Saya senang membantu. Mungkinkah tenggatnya diundur sampai Senin? Saya ingin memeriksa ulang beberapa data." Pak Hadi menjawab, "Itu tidak masalah. Terima kasih sudah memberi tahu saya."

Mr. Hadi, the manager, is writing to his team. "I would appreciate it if you could send me the sales report by Friday. Would you mind checking the numbers once more? If you could add a short summary, that would be even better."
Rina replies, "Of course, Mr. Hadi. I'd be happy to help. Would it be possible to extend the deadline until Monday? I would like to double-check some data." Mr. Hadi answers, "That would be fine. Thank you for letting me know."

read.id:
Tamu: Permisi, bisakah Anda memberi tahu di mana departemen keuangan? Resepsionis: Tentu. Ada di lantai tiga. Apakah Anda tahu siapa yang akan Anda temui? Tamu: Saya akan bertemu Pak Hadi. Bisakah Anda memberi tahu apakah beliau ada di kantornya?
Resepsionis: Saya akan memeriksa. Apakah Anda keberatan menunggu sebentar? Tamu: Sama sekali tidak. Saya ingin tahu apakah beliau tahu saya di sini. Resepsionis: Beliau tahu. Beliau bilang akan turun sendiri. Tamu: Terima kasih atas bantuan Anda.

read.text:
Visitor: Excuse me, could you tell me where the finance department is? Receptionist: Certainly. It is on the third floor. Do you know who you are meeting? Visitor: I'm meeting Mr. Hadi. Could you tell me if he is in his office?
Receptionist: I'll check. Would you mind waiting a moment? Visitor: Not at all. I wonder whether he knows I'm here. Receptionist: He does. He said he would come down himself. Visitor: Thank you for your help.
